verdict.rationale: Snyk CLI explicitly supports running locally or in CI/CD pipelines (snyk-gh-3), with concrete commands like `snyk test` and `snyk code test` (snyk-gh-2, snyk-gh-5), enabling headless automation for scanning open source, code, container, and IaC vulnerabilities. Community feedback confirms real-world CI integration experience, though with mixed sentiment on value (snyk-comm-8). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of CI performance at scale, and richer docs specifically on CI exit-code/threshold configuration for pipeline gating.
